projects.title: Vision-Based Planar Damage Segmentation & Laser Cladding Path Planning System
projects.description: Built a vision-based system for 2D planar damage segmentation and automatic laser cladding path planning, from camera image to ABB/FANUC robot code.
projects.title_zh: 基于视觉的平面损伤分割与激光熔覆路径规划系统
projects.description_zh: 搭建了从相机图像到 ABB/FANUC 机器人代码的视觉驱动系统，完成二维平面损伤分割与自动激光熔覆路径规划。

projects.title: SO101 · Lift Cube (IsaacLab RL)
projects.description: Trained an RL policy in IsaacLab (manage-based environment) for the SO101 gripper to grasp and lift a cube.
projects.title_zh: SO101 · 托举方块（Isaac Lab 强化学习）
projects.description_zh: 在 Isaac Lab（manager-based 环境）中为 SO101 夹爪训练了抓取并托举方块的 RL 策略。

projects.title: Delivery Robot AprilTag IR Localization
projects.description: Pose accuracy test of a restaurant delivery robot based on AprilTag, with an **infrared-enhanced AprilTag perception stack** for robust localization under real-world lighting and clutter.
projects.title_zh: 送餐机器人 AprilTag 红外定位精度测试
projects.description_zh: 基于 AprilTag 的餐厅送餐机器人位姿精度测试，采用 **红外增强 AprilTag 感知方案**，在真实光照与杂乱场景下实现稳定定位。

projects.title: image2usd
projects.description: Convert 2D images into 3D USD assets which could directly used for Isaac Sim.
projects.description_zh: 将二维图像转为可直接在 Isaac Sim 中使用的 3D USD 资产。

projects.title: Keyboard Control AmazingHand Use ROS2
projects.description: A ROS2 package that mirrors the original `AmazingHand_Demo.py` gestures and exposes. Allow keyboard control.
projects.title_zh: 基于 ROS2 的 AmazingHand 键盘控制
projects.description_zh: ROS2 包，复现并暴露原有 `AmazingHand_Demo.py` 的手势，支持键盘控制。

projects.title: Visual-tactile sensor grasping
projects.description: Combine single-image 6D pose estimation with **GelSight Mini** fingertip tactile sensing to detect slip, surface texture, and contact deformation for robust grasping.
projects.description_zh: 将单目 6D 位姿估计与 **GelSight Mini** 指尖触觉传感结合，检测打滑、表面纹理与接触变形，实现鲁棒抓取。

projects.title: Human legs tracking with 2D LiDAR
projects.description: Pedestrian tracking and avoid crashing on a mobile robot using a 2D LiDAR and the ROS leg_tracker pipeline.
projects.title_zh: 基于 2D 激光雷达的人腿跟踪
projects.description_zh: 在移动机器人上使用 2D 激光雷达与 ROS leg_tracker 流程实现行人跟踪与防撞。

projects.title: Isaac Sim / MoveIt Command and Observation Recorder
projects.description: A recording and visualization tool for comparing MoveIt joint commands with Isaac Sim observed joint positions.
projects.title_zh: Isaac Sim / MoveIt 指令与观测记录程序
projects.description_zh: 我写了一个记录和可视化程序，用来同时记录 MoveIt 下发的关节指令和 Isaac Sim 返回的关节观测位置，帮助定位机械臂仿真轨迹和现实轨迹不一致的问题。

projects.title: SO-ARM101 MoveIt in Isaac Sim
projects.description: Control the SO-ARM101 manipulator with MoveIt + ROS 2, and connect it to Isaac Sim via topic-based ros2_control.
projects.title_zh: SO-ARM101 在 Isaac Sim 中的 MoveIt 控制
projects.description_zh: 使用 MoveIt + ROS 2 控制 SO-ARM101 机械臂，并通过基于 topic 的 ros2_control 与 Isaac Sim 连接。

projects.title: Camera 2D LiDAR Joint Calibration
projects.description: Reproduced a GitHub camera–LiDAR calibration method, adapted it to a camera + 2D LiDAR setup, and documented it as an internal SOP.
projects.title_zh: 相机与 2D 激光雷达联合标定
projects.description_zh: 复现 GitHub 上的相机–激光雷达标定方法，适配到相机 + 2D 激光雷达方案，并整理为内部 SOP 文档。

projects.title: SO101 Imitation Learning — Lift Cube to Plate
projects.description: Use the SO101 robot arm for imitation learning: teleoperate to collect trajectories, then train a policy so the arm autonomously lifts a cube and places it on a plate.
projects.title_zh: SO101 模仿学习：托举方块到托盘
projects.description_zh: 使用 SO101 机械臂做模仿学习：先遥操作采集轨迹，再训练策略，使机械臂自主完成将方块托举到托盘上的任务。

projects.title: SO101 teleoperation
projects.description_zh: 使用 SO100 遥操作 SO101 机械臂。

projects.title: YOLOv8 Mobile Demo
projects.description: A lightweight YOLOv8 object detection demo running in real time on a mobile device.
projects.description_zh: 在移动设备上实时运行的轻量级 YOLOv8 目标检测演示。
